entries.hook: Curlhorn is a wild bull the Menagerie of Unfiled Beasts filed as a war-beast. The horns refuse the charge, and no faction has claimed the embarrassment.

entries.environmentName: The Infirmary of Too Much Care
entries.hook: Sheetwail is a corrupted echo who clocks into the Infirmary of Too Much Care before anyone is hurt. The wail is help that will not wait, and the Sanctuary Order does not employ her.

source.thaiName: กระดองขบวน

entries.environmentName: The Ballroom Stuck on One Dance
entries.hook: Shellmarch guards the Ballroom Stuck on One Dance by marching a parade that outranks the fight. The shell is a tower pose, with no town behind it and no faction banner on it.

source.thaiName: กระท่อมครก

entries.environmentName: The Roof Garden of Indoor Weather
entries.hook: Pestlehut is the Roof Garden's spinning hut, a tower anomaly that offers shelter and then turns the door away. It hands out no quest.

source.thaiName: ปากบัญชี

entries.hook: Ledgermaw is a misfiled legend clerking in the Archive of Unfinished Legends, hungry only for a sum that does not match. The bite is paper, and the archive still judges no one's life.

source.thaiName: วัวกลับทาง

entries.hook: Switchback keeps the Service Elevator Between Moods and treats the way you just came as the correct way. One car, one paddle, and no kingdom attached.

source.thaiName: กัดใบรับ

entries.hook: Claimbite is unclaimed luggage in the Lobby of Lost Badges that started checking tickets. It is a tower anomaly, and the lobby's lost-and-found is not a hoard.

source.thaiName: แอ่งเข้าเวร

entries.hook: Duty Puddle is wash-water that took a shift on the Pantry of Living Leftovers and treats a footstep as more work. No faction claims the puddle.

source.thaiName: เกราะสำรอง

entries.hook: Spare Plate wears Aegis Dominion's Tank joke and nothing else: empty armor of the wrong size, on duty in the Armory of Wrong Sizes. The armory is not that faction's capital, and the plate is neither Sir Potlid nor Justin Case.

source.thaiName: ยามหก

entries.environmentName: The Roof Garden of Indoor Weather
entries.hook: Spillguard is a wild creature who assigned itself to the Roof Garden's indoor puddles and loses authority whenever it bows. The water is the place it stands.

source.thaiName: จิ้งจอกบิล

entries.environmentName: The Gift Shop of the Conquered
entries.hook: Receiptfox is a wild fox at the Gift Shop of the Conquered, bewitching the ledger instead of the hero. That shop is not the Shopping Mall, and the fox founds no shrine.

source.thaiName: เขาลงเวลา

entries.hook: Hornstamp keeps a chair in the Basement of Retired Bosses and prosecutes lateness with one heavy stamp. The pose is a tower guardian's, and the basement is not a previous game's canon.

source.thaiName: เซ็นก่อน

entries.hook: Signfirst is a corrupted echo stuck in the Lobby of Lost Badges because the arrival will not count until the log is signed. That desk joke leaves Real People and Echo hybrid Avatars undefined.

source.thaiName: ซิปค้าง

entries.hook: Zipperhide is the Menagerie's hired suit, a guardian pose that cannot take the first step until the zipper moves. The eight named people stay out of the costume.

source.thaiName: ยังไม่จอด

entries.hook: Stilldock is a corrupted echo that mistook the Throne Landing of Maybe for a harbor and is still about to arrive. An elite on that landing leaves the floors unnumbered.

source.thaiName: เสมียนหมัดดิน

entries.hook: Clerk Claypunch is a tower guardian kneaded under the Lobby of Lost Badges, still blocking a queue that moved upstairs. He holds a Tank-shaped post and stays outside Aegis Dominion.

source.thaiName: หมวกชาด

entries.hook: Capper Crimson is a corrupted echo in the Armory of Wrong Sizes, furious that the cap will not stay the right red. He stands outside the four factions and still hits like a striker.

source.thaiName: เสมียนไร้คาง

entries.hook: Clerk Nochin is the pantry door itself, a tower guardian who announces a bite the missing jaw cannot finish. The Pantry of Living Leftovers keeps the bowl, and no new room was opened for him.

source.thaiName: ดามกระจก

entries.hook: Dame Glasspeck is a tower anomaly at the Mirror Well who rejects a form by looking at it. The glance is a tell, and she is not a member of Celestial Nexus.

source.thaiName: ผู้ตรวจส้นสปริง

entries.hook: Auditor Leapwell is a tower anomaly auditing the Corridor of Uninvited Footsteps from one balcony above the conversation. The leap is the tell, and Phantom Blades does not employ him.

source.thaiName: เซอร์เสื้อกั๊กเถ้า

entries.hook: Sir Cindervest guards a receipt vault in the Observatory of Bad Math, a dragon outline around a book that will not close. The title is a comedy rank, the ash is paint, and Aegis Dominion does not knight him.

source.thaiName: เซอร์พายุเขียว

entries.hook: Sir Verdant Gale is a tower guardian at the Throne Landing of Maybe who offers one honest blow and keeps the head in a hatbox. He is not an Aegis knight, and that landing is still not a locked last floor.

source.thaiName: เสมียนน้ำแยก

entries.hook: Clerk Forkwater is a wild creature coiled in the Service Elevator Between Moods because the heads will not agree which way the water leaves. The elevator's indecision carries that joke, and no flood biome was added.

source.thaiName: เซอร์ใยบันได

entries.hook: Sir Stairweb is a wild spider brokering stories on the Archive of Unfinished Legends stair and charging rent in being heard twice. He retells his own anecdote, and Celestial Nexus does not license him.

source.thaiName: กัปตันอีกรอบ

entries.environmentName: The Ballroom Stuck on One Dance
entries.hook: Captain Encore is a corrupted echo on the Ballroom Stuck on One Dance balcony who will not strike until the landing has heard the form-name. Phantom Blades does not own the shout.

source.thaiName: เซอร์ขดด้าย

entries.environmentName: The Roof Garden of Indoor Weather
entries.hook: Sir Yarncoil is a tower anomaly belted around the Roof Garden of Indoor Weather, still trying to measure the Mysterious Tower's waist. Letting the clasp go makes a hallway again, and it starts no doom and no quest.

source.thaiName: ดามกระบวยรั่ว

entries.hook: Dame Dryladle is a wild giant in the Basement of Retired Bosses, asking for a ladle that already has a hole. She is not one of the retired bosses, and the fifteen biomes include no sea, so the open ceiling does the work.

source.thaiName: เซอร์ทุ่งบัว

entries.hook: Sir Lotusbulk is a wild beast asleep on packing paper in the Menagerie of Unfiled Beasts, too courteous to be winched. The dock is a prop in that pen, and he is not an Aegis tank.

source.thaiName: ตู้ศูนย์

entries.environmentName: The Gift Shop of the Conquered
entries.hook: Zero Cabinet is an unlisted tower anomaly in the Gift Shop of the Conquered, a game the directory never stocked. Missing the door does not gate the tower, and the Void it boots from is the card pile.

source.thaiName: ดามตลับ

entries.environmentName: The Infirmary of Too Much Care
entries.hook: Dame Compact is an optional tower guardian on a hidden landing of the Infirmary of Too Much Care, and skipping her oath turns the blessing into the fine. The tower can be climbed without her, and Sanctuary Order does not post her.

crosswalkStatus: Historical. Superseded at research/m06-parody b7132e2, which cites ENV-TWR ids and ATTR ids directly. Kept so the first-watch clash stays readable.

unmappedEnvironments.reason: No ENV-TWR biome is a flooded holy room. Not added as a 16th environment. A later sample that needs water-and-relic should say so in conflicts instead of minting a floor.

environmentCrosswalk.note: Both are arrival bureaucracy. Theirs is a market. Ours is a badge lobby. Use ENV-TWR-01 unless the joke is specifically commerce, then flag partial.
Both are back-of-house transit. Theirs is tunnels. Ours is an elevator between moods.
Both are the roof. Their joke is laundry. Ours is indoor weather. Do not treat laundry as a second roof region.

elementCrosswalk.note: Their creative.element may stay as an art-color word. Lore stores attributeId. This is not permission to add an element enum to src/schema.

map.flag: Heat color only. Not a fire element.
Water as a place the creature stands, not a damage type.
Speed and push, lining up with DPS, not a wind element.
Mood. Not a dark element and not holy opposition to Gleam.
Bright mood. Not a light element and not Saving Grace.
Wrong-object armor color. Fits the Armory joke.

conflicts.theirClaim: creative.factionAffiliation may be Wild Creature, Corrupted Echo, Tower Guardian, Tower Anomaly, or one of the four faction ids.
conflicts.lorePosition: originId is one of ORG-WILD, ORG-ECHO, ORG-GUARD, ORG-ANOM, ORG-FACTION. factionId is null unless the joke wears a real faction, and required only for ORG-FACTION.
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Their guide now stores creative.originId separately and puts only a factionId or null in creative.factionAffiliation.

conflicts.theirClaim: Element is one of Cinder, Tide, Loam, Gale, Spark, Gloom, Bloom, Gleam, Scrap, Neutral. No Void.
conflicts.lorePosition: No element enum exists in src/schema. Research attributeId is ATTR_GUARD, ATTR_STRIKE, ATTR_ARCANE, ATTR_AID, ATTR_WILD, ATTR_ECHO, or ATTR_NEUTRAL. Void, Sync, and a Light/Dark pair stay banned on both sides.
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Their element field is now an attributeId from this framework. The Cinder/Tide list is no longer their working vocabulary. The crosswalk below is history.

conflicts.theirClaim: Normals are N, or R when the gag and the silhouette do extra work. Elites are R or Epic. Do not spend EX on the normal/elite sample. Do not use FAC.
conflicts.lorePosition: Default map is Normal N, Elite R, Mini Boss Epic, Main Boss EX, World Boss EX, Secret/Comedy Epic or EX only with a phase. FAC is never a monster rarity. Superseded words stay banned.
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Their normal/elite sample rule is now N and R. Epic and EX stay off that sample. FAC stays off monsters.

conflicts.canonImpact: none if the sentence stays about creatures
conflicts.theirClaim: Echo means the tower misremembered a story and the misfile grew legs. Marked PROPOSED, and it yields to Agent 08.
conflicts.lorePosition: ORG-ECHO is a hostile or wild creature that looks like a person done wrong. MAP-09's 'Real People + Echo hybrid Avatar' stays undefined. Echo Summoning is not a mechanic.
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Their guide refuses to define Echo, hybrid, or summoning, and it keeps the eight named people off the monster list.

conflicts.theirClaim: Provisional labels: Gate Market, Echo Archives, Service Tunnels, Flooded Reliquary, Unlicensed Observatory, Night Kitchen, Roof Laundry. Not canon regions.
conflicts.lorePosition: Fifteen ENV-TWR biomes are the research set. They are not locked floors (OPEN-07).
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Their tower field is now an ENV-TWR id. Flooded Reliquary is no longer a working label.

conflicts.canonImpact: none if the hook stays a desk joke
conflicts.theirClaim: The lore summary says something was summoned into the Lobby and gained a destiny.
conflicts.lorePosition: Echo Summoning is not a mechanic. MAP-09 stays the undefined phrase Real People + Echo hybrid Avatar.
conflicts.resolution: The link keeps ORG-ECHO and ENV-TWR-01. The hook treats the signature as the creature's problem and does not describe a rite.

conflicts.canonImpact: none if the word stays a nickname
conflicts.theirClaim: Boss lore addresses the climbing party as Hunters.
conflicts.lorePosition: This card game's party is four Avatars. The repo is a separate project from Hunter Life. Hunter is not a faction, a class, or a map pin.
conflicts.resolution: Hooks say party or leave the climbers unnamed. Do not import Hunter Life. Do not add a hunter faction.

conflicts.theirClaim: Each boss notes a Tank, DPS, Magic, or Support shape. Clerk Claypunch's note says the engine loader still requires a faction id, and the record does not invent one.
conflicts.lorePosition: The four roles belong to the four factions on Avatars. A monster's staging shape does not join a faction and does not satisfy an avatar faction field.
conflicts.resolution: Every boss link keeps factionId null. Do not mint a faction id so a loader will accept the record.

conflicts.theirClaim: attributeId is ATTR_WILD and engineRoleShape is Magic.
conflicts.lorePosition: ATTR_WILD has no faction. Magic is Celestial Nexus's locked avatar role. A wild creature may look arcane in play without joining that faction.
conflicts.resolution: Link keeps ORG-WILD, ATTR_WILD, factionId null. The Magic shape is staging only.

conflicts.source: research/m07-boss@76360d6 Sir Cindervest loreSummary versus notes.originId
conflicts.theirClaim: The lore calls him the floor's Tower Guardian and, in the same breath, an Echo that grew a dragon outline. notes.originId is ORG-GUARD.
conflicts.lorePosition: A link stores one originId. Echo hybrid Avatars stay undefined either way.
conflicts.resolution: The link uses ORG-GUARD, matching the notes field and the vault-keeper joke. The Echo clause stays flavor inside that guardian, not a second origin.

conflicts.theirClaim: No ENV-TWR biome is a flood. The sample uses ENV-TWR-13 because the elevator cannot agree which floor to open.
conflicts.lorePosition: The fifteen biomes are the set. OPEN-07 still has no floor list. A sixteenth flood floor would be a new proposal past the set.
conflicts.resolution: Accepted their mapping. The link does not add a biome.

conflicts.theirClaim: ENV-TWR-10 is the Basement of Retired Bosses. This world boss is not retired. The room is used for an open ceiling. There is no sea biome.
conflicts.lorePosition: Same fifteen-biome cap. A partial postcard is allowed. It does not rename the basement.
conflicts.resolution: Accepted ENV-TWR-10. The hook says the fit is partial.

conflicts.theirClaim: The name is Dame and the lore uses she. The phase line says the lighting change does not erase him.
conflicts.lorePosition: One figure, one presentation. This is inside the sample, not a faction rule.
conflicts.resolution: The hook uses Dame and she. The phase line should be aligned by Agent 07 when they next edit. Lore does not rename her.

conflicts.theirClaim: A world-scale dock beast is filed in the Menagerie. The sample says lotus crates are props, not a new dock biome.
conflicts.lorePosition: ENV-TWR-08 may hold him. World-boss scale is presentation, not a new region and not a raid.
conflicts.resolution: Accepted ENV-TWR-08. No dock biome added.

conflicts.theirClaim: originId is ORG-ANOM and attributeId is ATTR_ECHO. The note correctly says the Void in the mechanic is the card pile.
conflicts.lorePosition: ATTR_ECHO is the look of a person or a legend done wrong. A cabinet that was never stocked is an anomaly first. Void stays a pile, which their note already says.
conflicts.resolution: Link keeps their ids so the sample and the link match, and flags the stretch. Do not retcon ATTR_ECHO into a definition of hybrid avatars.

conflicts.theirClaim: An elite and a main boss share the Throne Landing of Maybe.
conflicts.lorePosition: Biomes may repeat. The elite does not become a world boss, and the landing is not floor N.
conflicts.resolution: Both links kept. No floor number assigned.

conflicts.theirClaim: Two normals and a world boss share the Roof Garden.
conflicts.lorePosition: Shared postcard. World scale on Sir Yarncoil is presentation.

conflicts.theirClaim: Two normals and a world boss share the Menagerie.

conflicts.lorePosition: The branch has since published 15 bosses.
conflicts.resolution: Closed. Boss links are in entries.

sharedPostcards.note: Three lobby creatures. Different silhouettes: luggage, sign-in echo, clay clerk.
Two normals share the menagerie with a world boss. Scale stays presentation.
Hut, lifeguard, and the waist-measuring anomaly share the roof garden.
An elite ship and a main-boss challenger share the Maybe landing. The elite does not become the final floor.
